title: rex-addons manifest.json
description: What an addon is, for rex-addons 0.7. The rules are the ones installing checks; four it checks that this file can't are that each config key is listed once, that requires doesn't name the addon's own id, that a select's option values are each given once, and that its default is one of them. https://github.com/debridmediamanager/rex-addons/blob/main/docs/writing-addons.md#manifestjson

$schema.description: Where your editor finds this file. rex-addons ignores it.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and -, starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters. It's the addon's name in rex too (addon-<id>), so never change it.

name.description: What people see in the app.

description.description: What people see in the app.

version.description: Numbers and dots. Raise it with every change: people see an update when the version in your repository is higher than theirs.

hosts.description: The websites fetch() may reach, and that open() links may point at: example.com exactly, *.example.com for anything under it, or * for any public website. This device (127.0.0.1, localhost) is never reachable. An address on a private network is reachable only when you list it exactly, or the person types it into a host setting (that port only); never through * or *.example.com.

config.description: The settings the app shows. Each key once.

refresh_minutes.description: How often items() runs. Default 360, at least 5.

host.description: The lowest rex-addons version your addon needs, such as "0.2". 0.2: sleep, atob, btoa, URL, URLSearchParams, hash, hmac, bytes(), a binary body. 0.3: sign_in. 0.4: playlists from open(). 0.5: "kind": "spotify", exports, requires. 0.6: select settings, storage.keys, TextEncoder, TextDecoder, crypto, md5 and bytes in hash and hmac, ctx.host, ctx.addon, ctx.reason, RETRY_AFTER. 0.7: host settings.

directories.description: Libraries of the addon's own, in rex's directories shape, such as [{"name": "youtube", "shows": "YouTube"}]: titles whose path starts with youtube/ go to a TV library called YouTube. https://github.com/debridmediamanager/rex/blob/main/docs/feed-api.md#libraries-a-source-declares

sign_in.description: For an addon that needs the person's account on a website, such as {"label": "Sign in to Example"}. Needs "host": "0.3" (0.5 with "kind": "spotify").

label.description: What the app's button says. Default: Sign in to <name>.

exports.description: Functions of your default export that other addons may call, such as ["findSong"]. Needs "host": "0.5".

requires.description: Ids of addons whose exports yours calls, such as ["youtube"], never your own. Needs "host": "0.5".

host_0_5.description: sign_in kind spotify, exports and requires need "host": "0.5" or newer.

host_0_6.description: A select setting needs "host": "0.6" or newer.

host_0_7.description: A host setting needs "host": "0.7" or newer.

key.description: Letters, digits and _, each key once. ctx.config.<key> holds its value.

label.description: What the app shows. Default: the key.

type.description: text, secret (shown masked), bool, number, list (a list of text), select (one of its options; needs "host": "0.6") or host (an address the person types, such as 192.168.1.20:8096: the addon may then reach that host on that port; no default; needs "host": "0.7").

options.description: A select's choices, such as [{"value": "1080", "label": "1080p"}]: the app shows each label, your code gets the value. Each value once.

help.description: A line of text the app shows with the setting. An older rex-addons ignores it.

default.description: The value until one is saved. Of the setting's type.

required.description: true: a sync fails with "set <label> first" while it is empty.

secret.description: On a list: shows only each link's website, for links that carry a key.
